articles.imageAlt: Fintech API Security Architecture and Data Protection Controls
articles.imageDescription: Diagram of secure API gateway with mTLS and tokenized PII exchange
articles.content:
Exposed Fintech Endpoints in Africa

As Nigerian financial institutions accelerate digital onboarding, third-party KYC aggregators and API gateways are frequently found leaking Personally Identifiable Information (PII) during BVN and NIN validation calls.

Key Vulnerabilities Observed

  • Unauthenticated verification webhooks exposing full customer BVN records.
  • Overly permissive CORS headers on mobile backend microservices.
  • Lack of payload encryption for biometric exchange endpoints.

Remediation Controls

Security engineers must enforce mTLS for all bank-to-fintech connections, mask PII in transit, and implement automated token revocation policies.

articles.imageCaption: Cloud Security Pod Architecture in AWS af-south-1
articles.imageDescription: AWS architecture diagram showing IAM guardrails and S3 block public access
articles.content:
The Hidden Cost of Cloud Insecurity

Over 70% of cloud security incidents among African tech startups stem from trivial misconfigurations rather than sophisticated zero-day exploits. Here is how to audit your cloud posture in under 30 minutes.

Top Three AWS Exposure Vectors

  1. Public S3 Buckets containing database snapshots: Ensure AWS S3 Block Public Access is enforced at the organization root level.
  2. Security Groups with 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22 or 3389: Replace direct SSH with AWS Systems Manager (SSM) Session Manager.
  3. Root user accounts without Hardware MFA: Enforce strict FIDO2/WebAuthn keys on all AWS root identities.
